2607.11343.title: Longitudinal Multi-View Breast Cancer Risk Prediction
2607.11343.paper_summary: Accurate breast cancer risk prediction from screening mammography is critical for enabling personalized screening intervals and early detection. Recent deep learning methods have shown the value of longitudinal data and explicit temporal alignment. However, existing approaches either perform explicit alignment using a single mammographic view or model multiple views without explicit longitudinal alignment, limiting their ability to exploit the complementary spatial-temporal information used in clinical practice. To address this gap, we propose LMV-Net, a longitudinal multi-view breast cancer risk prediction model that jointly analyzes anatomically complementary CC and MLO views within an explicitly aligned longitudinal framework. We evaluate our approach on the public EMBED and CSAW-CC datasets, comparing it to state-of-the-art breast cancer risk prediction methods. Our model consistently outperforms existing approaches in overall risk prediction performance and across different breast density and cancer subgroups. Importantly, these improvements highlight the potential of longitudinal multi-view modeling to enhance risk stratification, paving the way for future work on personalized screening, earlier identification of high-risk patients, and more efficient screening resource allocation. The code is available at https://github.com/sot176/LMV-Net.
2607.11343.paper_summary_zh: 準確的乳腺癌風險預測來自篩檢乳房攝影，對於實現個性化篩檢間隔和早期檢測至關重要。最近的深度學習方法顯示了縱向數據和明確時間對齊的價值。然而，現有的方法要麼使用單一的乳房攝影視圖進行明確對齊，要麼在沒有明確縱向對齊的情況下建模多個視圖，限制了它們利用臨床實踐中使用的互補空間-時間信息的能力。為了解決這一問題，我們提出了LMV-Net，一種縱向多視圖乳腺癌風險預測模型，該模型在明確對齊的縱向框架內共同分析解剖上互補的CC和MLO視圖。我們在公共的EMBED和CSAW-CC數據集上評估我們的方法，並將其與最先進的乳腺癌風險預測方法進行比較。我們的模型在整體風險預測性能以及不同乳腺密度和癌症亞組中始終優於現有方法。重要的是，這些改進突顯了縱向多視圖建模在增強風險分層方面的潛力，為未來在個性化篩檢、高風險患者的早期識別以及更有效的篩檢資源配置方面的工作鋪平了道路。代碼可在 https://github.com/sot176/LMV-Net 獲得。
